episode_summary: In this episode, Danny Brown shares insights into building a successful luxury real estate practice by focusing on integrity and strong relationships. He discusses the importance of securing buyer representation agreements and the nuances of working with ultra high net worth clients. The episode also covers strategies for moving upmarket and maintaining a lean yet profitable operation.
